alternatives.label: International management and organisational strategy
alternatives.concept: A broad management curriculum connects international strategy and governance with accounting, finance, economics, law, marketing, organisational behaviour, leadership and quantitative and qualitative research. Its social-science methods complement Radboud’s integrated organisational curriculum; UCR does not reproduce the compulsory Global Value Chains or IBA thesis sequence. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. External thesis-entry requirements remain unresolved; this composition is provisional research.
alternatives.labelReason: The title names the dominant course sequence: cross-border business and organisational strategy with economics, management and research methods.
progression: Current workbook offerings and formal earlier prerequisites pass after rescheduling;all24courses retained,4perterm,Year1PPD,advancedminimum. Datatools precede ML in analytics. Courselevels alone do not impose extra entry rules. This mechanical result does not certify external thesis progression.
traceOverrides: uses consumer research, team product development and cost analysis to practice entrepreneurship in an organisational setting
examines how AI adoption changes firms, workers, innovation and governance through business cases
Its strategic plan,industry cases andresponsible digital-transformation analysis directly support management strategy;not a separate technical analytics sequence.

alternatives.label: Responsible enterprise and sustainable change
alternatives.concept: A responsible-enterprise curriculum joins entrepreneurship and organisational leadership to climate, circular-economy assessment and sustainability governance. It studies the environmental constraints and social value of business decisions through both management and environmental-science courses; specialist IBA value-chain and thesis requirements remain distinct. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. External thesis-entry requirements remain unresolved; this composition is provisional research.
alternatives.labelReason: The title names the dominant course sequence: sustainable enterprise with climate, circular-economy and governance courses.
progression: Current workbook offerings and formal earlier prerequisites pass after rescheduling;all24courses retained,4perterm,Year1PPD,advancedminimum. Datatools precede ML in analytics. Courselevels alone do not impose extra entry rules. This mechanical result does not certify external thesis progression.
alternatives.distinctness: Six course replacements (45 EC) shift the first programme toward environmental science, life-cycle assessment, sustainability governance and public economics; these implement the named responsible-enterprise evidence and change the academic work, not merely the title.
traceOverrides: uses consumer research, team product development and cost analysis to practice entrepreneurship in an organisational setting
examines how AI adoption changes firms, workers, innovation and governance through business cases
Its strategic plan,industry cases andresponsible digital-transformation analysis directly support management strategy;not a separate technical analytics sequence.

alternatives.label: Business analytics and digital innovation
alternatives.concept: A digital-business curriculum combines strategy, finance, markets and organisations with programming, databases, mathematical methods, data science, machine learning and AI ethics. The computational sequence provides practical data skills behind digital innovation while leaving Radboud’s independent IBA thesis and detailed organisational requirements distinct. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. External thesis-entry requirements remain unresolved; this composition is provisional research.
alternatives.labelReason: The title names the dominant course sequence: business decisions with a substantial programming, data and AI sequence.
progression: Current workbook offerings and formal earlier prerequisites pass after rescheduling;all24courses retained,4perterm,Year1PPD,advancedminimum. Datatools precede ML in analytics. Courselevels alone do not impose extra entry rules. This mechanical result does not certify external thesis progression.
alternatives.distinctness: The programming, database, data-science, machine-learning, deep-learning, mathematics and AI-ethics sequence changes the actual methods of study. It differs by nine courses (67.5 EC) from management and by eleven (82.5 EC) from sustainable enterprise, and both differences implement the evidenced digital expertise direction.

Both teach marketing decisions and engagement with consumers; Radboud also integrates strategy.
Both analyse the functioning of organisations; UCR emphasises psychology of leadership.
Both consider creating value through enterprise; UCR’s team product design includes explicit sustainability analysis.
Both address people in organisations;UCR studies inclusive leadership,emotion regulation andpsychologicalsafety with empiricalsurveyresearch,not the full strategicHRM toolkit.
Both examine digital technologies,innovation andorganisational value creation;UCR concentrates onAIbusiness/economic/governance cases,not the whole innovation-management field.
Distinct organisation/job-design principles;leadership andgeneralstrategy do not establish the same design training.
Both treat international coordination and governance across business actors; UCR does not cover the full value-chain sequence.
Both develop strategy for changing competitive and international business environments; UCR emphasises digital transformation.
Both analyse international-market and consumer evidence; UCR teaches market research rather than all international-marketing functions.
Shared strategy study is already placed once at InternationalStrategy;negotiation is not a replacement for this advanced firm-strategy course.
Organisationalchange cases andprocess theory are distinct from personalleadership;other partlyrelated managementcourses are alreadyplaced once.
No scheduled UCR course directly covers the specifically credited System Theory component at comparable scope; it remains distinct.
Both introduce economic reasoning for business settings.
Both teach financial/managementaccounting,statements,control andperformance;UCR also teaches investmentappraisal. They do not have identical creditweight orscope.
Shared financialmarkets,instruments andfinancing decisions;UCR centresbanks,interest risk andmonetaryinstitutions,whileRadboud additionally focuses oncorporate projectinvestment andfinancingchoice.
Both develop source evaluation,academicwriting,literature synthesis andresearchquestions;UCR adds personal/civicdevelopment,whileRadboud culminates in a reviewstudy.
Both develop quantitative research design and statistical analysis.
Both teach qualitative social research methods applicable to organisations.
Both advance quantitative analysis; UCR teaches econometric modelling rather than a general business-methods sequence.
No scheduled UCR course directly covers the specifically credited Bachelor’s Thesis IBA component at comparable scope; it remains distinct.
Responsible-business management integrates social,environmental andeconomicvalue;public sustainabilitygovernance is a contextual complement,not the same primary organisational-management inquiry.
Both study the ethical consequences of organisational choices; UCR’s case domain is AI rather than international business.
An integrated responsible-organisation analysis project is distinct from alreadyplaced generalmethods/statistics andselfleadership.
No scheduled UCR course directly covers the specifically credited Flexibility window component at comparable scope; it remains distinct.

notes.text: The UCR alternatives can share international strategy, marketing, economics, organisational behaviour and business research with Radboud while concentrating differently on sustainable enterprise or technical analytics. Radboud’s prescribed Global Value Chains, Systems Theory and independent IBA thesis remain separate requirements; the 30-EC third-year flexibility window is genuine choice space.

audience.programmeDescription: International Business Administration studies how organisations operate across borders and respond to economic, social and environmental change. It combines management, marketing, finance and organisational research with responsible enterprise.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR programmes offer three different emphases: broad international management, responsible enterprise with environmental science, or business decisions with technical data analysis. They include substantial business study and related research skills. They do not reproduce every IBA requirement, including detailed global value chains, systems theory and the independent IBA thesis. Radboud’s thesis-entry rule still names older methods courses; its application to the renewed curriculum needs clarification.
